fusions.name: Swat on the Snout
fusions.desc: Swats musk into the target's face, dealing 15 damage, stunning it for 1.2 seconds and leaving it [Blunted] and 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Big Things Back Off
fusions.desc: Sprays a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 26 damage to everything in it, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaving it [Poisoned] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Shared Winter Den
fusions.desc: Digs a den where you stand. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Fat and Foul
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 12, and your poison resistance rises by 12%.
